title: Aerated Kenyan Tripe Bisque
description: A unique, plant-based take on a traditional bisque, incorporating aerated and resinous elements.
instructions: 1. In a medium saucepan, combine the kenyan and bisque. Heat over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
2. Add the aerated and resinous to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
3. Reduce heat to low and let simmer for 10-12 minutes.
4. Stir in nutritional yeast and let cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
6. Serve hot, garnished with additional aerated and resinous if desired.
